info.title: NigeriaStack — State & 774-Jurisdiction Municipal Interoperability API (review candidate)
info.summary: Interoperable interface patterns under NS-RFC-014; never a central operating API
info.description: Unbundled contracts for authority-owned deployments. Each state/LGA/area council/TSP hosts its own instance. Existing v2026.6.2 and attached v2026.6.5 are source baselines; this version is an additive review candidate, not ratified.

x-nigeriastack-compatibility.sourceConflict: Attached envelopeUlid uses kbd_ vs existing canonical repository envelopeUlid uses cop_
x-nigeriastack-compatibility.resolution: Keep existing envelopeUlid=cop_ for operation, kioskBaseDeltaId=kbd_ for CRDT. Introduce versioned adapters, never silently reinterpret IDs.
x-nigeriastack-compatibility.fctCase: FC-AC-01..06 distinct from regular XX-LGA-##. Validate against 774 registry lookup, not regex alone.
x-nigeriastack-compatibility.statefulOperations: No offline final seals; money transfers require independently verified bank confirmation; legal decisions require competent issuer.
